name: What is the difference between a general contractor and a remodeling project manager?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a general contractor and a remodeling project manager?

acceptedAnswer.text: While a general contractor directly executes and oversees the construction work, a remodeling project manager can offer a broader scope of oversight, often starting earlier in the planning phase and focusing more on strategic coordination, budgeting, and client advocacy. For complex residential projects in places like Mill Valley or Daly City, a project manager ensures that all aspects, including design, permitting, and various trades, are harmonized, acting as your central point of contact.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor executes construction, while a remodeling project manager provides broader oversight, strategic coordination, budgeting, and client advocacy.
